answer_text:
For a five-person team you want something that's quick to set up, keeps the pipeline visible and doesn't need an admin. These are the strongest options right now:

1. Northwind CRM Essentials - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Halcyon Sales - great for outbound-heavy teams, overkill if you mostly handle inbound leads.
3. Pipewell - easy to adopt, but email features cost extra.

Start with Northwind CRM if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Halcyon Sales if you expect to need deeper reporting.
